entry: Freeze-protection bypass valve opened for the spring start-up
Fan motor replaced after a bearing failure (spare motor from stores)
Hot water thermocouple TE-2H replaced (old one noisy)
Fan stack extended by 2.4 m (vendor upgrade kit); fan back in service 15:00
Riser isolation valve shut and blind flange fitted, fan locked out, basin drained: cell out of service for fill replacement (new film fill, same type as design)
Cell returned to service with new fill (blind flange removed, riser valve reopened 14:00)
Inspection: freeze-protection bypass valve found passing; replacement valve ordered for the October outage
